description: This file contains the implementation of the PersistentStreamPullingAgent class, which manages pulling messages from a queue, handling subscriptions, delivering messages to consumers, and managing stream state within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: PersistentStreamPullingAgent
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the pulling of messages from a queue, handling subscriptions, and delivering messages to stream consumers within Orleans streaming framework.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the pulling agent, setting up queue cache, receiver, and timer for polling messages.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the agent, disposing resources, stopping timers, and unregistering producers.

methods.name: AddSubscriber
methods.description: Adds a new subscriber to a stream, initiating handshake and starting message delivery.

methods.name: RemoveSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from a stream.

methods.name: PumpQueue
methods.description: Main loop that reads messages from the queue and processes them.

methods.name: ReadFromQueue
methods.description: Reads messages from the queue, updates cache, and manages stream activity.

methods.name: RunConsumerCursor
methods.description: Delivers messages to a consumer cursor, handling errors and flow control.
